summary:
Done. Verdict is now **"ok"**.

## What the game is
**Cat's Sunny Way Home** — you play the hand-drawn cat, collect all 5 little suns scattered across tree-top platforms, then reach the house door on the right to win. A patrolling car knocks the cat back and costs one of 3 lives on a side hit (landing on its roof is safe); losing all lives or running out the 90-second timer loses. All five player drawings (cat, sun, tree, house, car) appear as-is, with the world behind them drawn in Draw2D shapes.

**Controls:** Left/Right (A/D or arrows) to run, Jump (Space) to leap onto trees, any key (action) to restart after winning or losing.

## What was wrong and what I changed
- **Missing `progress` signal:** `state()` had no `progress` field, so the verifier's search player had no gradient and never won ("unproven"). I added `progress`: 85% weight on suns collected, a small proximity bonus toward the nearest remaining sun, 14% for approaching the house door once all suns are gathered, and 1 on win.
- **Slightly eased the car hazard** (same game, same roles): patrol speed 125→105, pickup radius widened a bit (52/55→60/62 px), post-hit invulnerability 90→110 frames — the car still kills every dumb policy (hold-right dies in ~300 frames).

## Verified
- `doctor --json`: all checks ok.
- `sim --mash 7 --frames 1800`: reacts to input, entities stay in-world, ends lost at frame 1581 with progress 0.38.
- `snap --frame 300`: no warnings; I read the PNG — cat, trees, suns, car, house, and HUD all render correctly.
- `bunx tsc --noEmit -p .`: clean.
- Playtester (`verify.ts drawing-1`): verdict **"ok"** — search player wins (320 frames, progress 1), no dumb policy (idle, holds, taps, mashes) wins.
- Golden replay recorded to `replays/mash.json` (1581 frames, checksum 3490495614).
